CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a whip pan that resolves onto the subject on a 40mm anamorphic, framing with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
